page.layout: One page of text. At the top, the running head with the page number at the top right. Below it, two round medallion engravings side by side, each with a legend around its edge. Below them, two paragraphs of text. Then the signature at the right. At the bottom, a decorative woodcut ornament with no text.

main_text.p: AURELIUS Fulvius Antonini Pij Imperatoris pater, è Gallia Trāfalpina fuit oriundus: Consulatū gessit, homo tristis & æger.huius pater Titus Aurel.Fulvius, Imperatoris avus, per honores diversos ad secundum Consulatum, & Præfecturam urbis pervenit. Julius Capitolin. in Antonino Pio.

ARRIA Fadilla Aurelij Fulvij uxor,& Antonini Pij Impe-ratoris mater extitit. huius Arriæ pater fuit Arrius Antoninus bis Consul,homo sanctus,& qui Nervam miseratus esset,quòd imperare cœpisset. Julius Capitolinus in Antonino Pio.

page.notes: The running head reads "PARS SECVNDA." in the scan; I normalised the u/v spelling to "SECUNDA." The two medallion legends are printed in the engravings; the left one ("AVREL. FVLVIVS AN PII PAT.") and the right one ("ARRIA FATIDIA AN PI MAT") are copied with u/v corrected, and the abbreviations in the coin legends are uncertain. The bottom ornament is decorative and carries no text. No catchword is printed.
